title.evidence_quote: Mads Øvlisen Postdoc Fellowships 2027 - Novo Nordisk Fonden

qualifications: PhD or equivalent research qualification; no limit on years since the PhD
Hosting letter from a Danish university, museum or knowledge institution
Applicants living outside Denmark must show that more than 50% of the project will be conducted in Denmark
If the thesis is not approved by the deadline, a supervisor's statement must be submitted by 29 March 2027
description_short: Novo Nordisk Foundation Mads Øvlisen Postdoc Fellowships 2027, for projects conducted mainly in Denmark with a Danish host institution. The call opens 30 October 2026 and closes 14 January 2027 at 2:00pm Copenhagen time; results are announced in May 2027.

deadline.evidence_quote: closes on 14 January 2027 at 2:00 pm Copenhagen time
